title: 17-year-old NDA Cadet Dies After Training Parade, Third Death in a Year
summary: A 17-year-old National Democratic Alliance (NDA) cadet died after participating in a training parade in Pune, Maharashtra. This is the third death of an NDA cadet in a year, highlighting concerns about the safety and well-being of young recruits. The incident has sparked debate about the risks associated with military training and the need for improved safety measures.
summary_points: A 17-year-old NDA cadet died after participating in a training parade in Pune, Maharashtra.
This is the third death of an NDA cadet in a year, raising concerns about safety and well-being.

The cause of death has not been officially confirmed, but it is believed to be related to a heart attack.
